description: The app's windows — the workspace windows and the Quick Actions panel. Deliberately minimal: no webview gets shell, filesystem, or HTTP permission of its own — every daemon call goes through a Rust command, so the daemon's bearer token never enters a webview and a compromised page cannot reach 127.0.0.1 directly. `w*` is the workspace windows opened after the first (see src/workspace.rs); it is a pattern rather than a list because the labels are minted at runtime, and it stays as narrow as the set of windows this app actually creates.
